title: Terrain-aware multibeam survey-line planning from public bathymetric priors
description: Analysis code, benchmark definitions, and derived outputs for a public-grid numerical benchmark of terrain-aware depth-referenced MBES fixed-line planning. The package supports public GEBCO 2025 scenes, synthetic stress tests, a USGS Southern Cascadia 30 m public-grid extension, coarse-prior/fine-grid replay, execution-uncertainty replay, optimization diagnostics, segmented decision auditing, and sensitivity analyses. The package is scoped to planning-stage fixed-line MBES survey-layout evidence; realized survey execution, raw MBES product validation, and charting-product assessment are outside this release.
